metaData.originalTitle: 装上就有 6 个 AI“牛马”帮你干活？腾讯 Marvis 内测
metaData.title: Install It and Get 6 AI "Workhorses" to Help You Work? Tencent Marvis Beta
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent App Store team launches operating system-level AI assistant "Marvis", capable of directly managing files, modifying system settings, controlling mobile apps, and featuring an on-device model for privacy mode.
metaData.summary: The article introduces "Marvis", an AI Agent product launched by the Tencent App Store team, positioned as an operating system-level AI assistant. Unlike traditional AI assistants, Marvis is deeply integrated into the system's underlying architecture, enabling it to directly perform tasks such as file management, document parsing, system setting modifications (e.g., disabling Windows ads), and hardware configuration checks without requiring manual user intervention. Its core differentiator lies in deep collaborations with companies like Microsoft, Intel, and Qualcomm, granting it low-level system access. It employs a routing mechanism to automatically assign tasks to local or cloud-based models and supports a privacy mode that runs entirely on-device. The product also includes a cartoon-style Agent studio with multiple preset roles working collaboratively. The team emphasizes that Marvis is a product that "grew" organically rather than being a conceptual design, and future iterations will continue to focus on its positioning as a system-level AI assistant.

mainPoints.point: Marvis is positioned as an operating system-level AI assistant, not a single-function AI product.
mainPoints.explanation: Unlike AI PPT tools or specific utilities, Marvis is deeply integrated into the system's underlying architecture, allowing it to directly manage files, modify settings, and execute tasks, functioning essentially as an AI-powered "File Explorer".

mainPoints.point: Marvis uses a routing mechanism to automatically assign tasks to local or cloud models and supports a privacy mode.
mainPoints.explanation: The system automatically routes tasks to local or cloud models based on complexity. Some local models can run offline, and privacy mode relies entirely on on-device models, achieving zero token consumption.

mainPoints.point: Marvis's core advantage lies in its deep collaborations with companies like Microsoft, Intel, and Qualcomm, granting it low-level system access.
mainPoints.explanation: This collaboration allows it to directly read software and hardware information, modify system settings, and optimize on-device model inference efficiency—a differentiated capability difficult for other Agent products to replicate.

mainPoints.point: Marvis supports controlling mobile apps from the desktop, potentially helping the PC industry "reclaim" mobile usage time.
mainPoints.explanation: Leveraging the App Store's ecosystem advantages, users can directly operate Android apps on their PC (e.g., for check-in tasks), support multiple instances, and without taking over keyboard and mouse control.

keyQuotes: We are an AI that runs through the operating system layer, a personalized AI assistant, not a product like AI PPT or something like making a lobster (Openclaw).
Marvis is not a concept product born out of a brainstorm; it is a product that 'grew' out of the team's existing genes and ecological niche.
It's called Marvis, a bit of a nod to the concept of Jarvis.
It is an AI Agent that has mastered the Resource Manager—it can not only converse but also operate; not only answer but also execute; not only in the cloud but also inside your computer.
